method: CTMSR Stage 1 (You et al., ICCV 2025): consistency training on a ResShift-style residual trajectory, one-step inference, no teacher

consistency._source: authors' options/train/ctmsr_train.yml: sigma 0..1 and alpha 0..1 linear (noise_rho = res_rho = 1), steps curriculum 4 -> 3; preconditioning sigma_data 0.5 (edm_unet_arch.py)

model._inputs: E02's U-Net and inputs, for a fair comparison: x_t (1) + cond: damaged print, mask, cos 2theta, sin 2theta (4); time input 1000 sigma. The paper uses a pixel-unshuffle Swin U-Net.

training._deviations: paper: 500K iterations at fixed lr 5e-5 (code: AdamW betas 0.9/0.9, EMA 0.999). Here 50k at lr 1e-4 and grad clip 1 (E02's; not in the paper) as a safety net for an unattended run.
